title: Weddings | R&SVP – Hio Ridge, Bridgton, Maine
description: Picture your day at our barn wedding venue in Bridgton, Maine. Ceremony and reception on one farm. Up to 135 guests. Sundays and weekdays, May through October.
heading: Your guests in the field. *The mountain beyond.*
lede: Stand beside each other facing Pleasant Mountain, with your family and friends on the benches. Then gather in the barn for dinner. We host ceremonies and receptions on our 22 acre farm in Bridgton, Maine, for up to 135 guests.
hero_alt: Benches in the ceremony field and the farmhouse in evening light

day.heading: From getting dressed to gathering for dinner

steps.title: Get ready in the ell
steps.body: Hang your dress on its hook and get ready with your wedding party nearby. We have separate rooms for the bride's and groom's parties in the ell beside the barn.

steps.title: Say your vows facing Pleasant Mountain
steps.body: Your guests take their seats on benches made from the barn's old floorboards. Our ceremony field faces Pleasant Mountain. Ask Susan about indoor arrangements as you plan for the weather.

steps.title: Sit down to dinner together
steps.body: Take your seats beneath the old beams and share the meal you've chosen. Tables and chairs come with the rental. Your caterer can finish the food in our prep kitchen.

steps.title: Catch up on the patio
steps.body: Take a photograph in the evening light or catch up with family on the patio. We have outdoor string lights and a stone seating circle in the field.

details.label: When
details.value: Sundays, May through October. We also book Monday through Friday

details.value: The field faces Pleasant Mountain. Ask Susan about indoor ceremony arrangements

details.value: Ask for the pricing brochure. [CONFIRM: starting price]

sunday.heading: A Sunday wedding at the farm
sunday.body: A Sunday ceremony gives guests the option of traveling on Saturday. We host weddings on Sundays and weekdays, May through October. We don't book Saturdays. Compare your vendors' Sunday and weekday rates as you plan your budget, and let guests know early so they can plan for Monday. [CONFIRM: wording Susan is comfortable with]

faq.q: How many guests can we invite?
faq.a: We welcome up to 135 guests per event. That is our total event capacity. Ask Susan to review dining and ceremony layouts for your guest count.

faq.q: Can we have our ceremony outside?
faq.a: Yes. Our ceremony field faces Pleasant Mountain. Your guests sit on benches made from the barn's old floorboards, and your reception can be on the same farm.
Ask Susan to walk through the indoor ceremony and reception arrangements for your guest count before you book. [CONFIRM: indoor ceremony capacity, room changeover and when the rain decision is made]

faq.q: Can we bring our own caterer?
faq.a: We have a prep kitchen for your caterer. They can close its barn doors while they finish your meal. Ask Susan about caterer requirements before you book a vendor.
We host weddings without alcohol. Guests of all ages are welcome, and there's no alcohol bill to add to your budget. Our town permit requires events to stay alcohol free.
Yes. We welcome families with children. Tell Susan about any needs you'd like to discuss for your youngest guests.
We don't book Saturdays. We host Sunday weddings and also book weekdays, May through October.
We host events from May through October. For an autumn wedding, picture the foliage on Pleasant Mountain beyond the ceremony field.
Yes. We include tables and chairs with rental. We have tables measuring 6 or 8 feet long and round tables. Ask Susan which arrangement suits your guest count.

We have three accessible parking spaces in the driveway and a wooden ramp to the main floor. We also have an ADA bathroom and a paved path to the patio. Ask Susan about access to the ceremony field and other rooms.
Contact Susan to schedule a tour and request our pricing brochure. You can ask about dates before choosing one. [CONFIRM: deposit and booking steps]

faq.q: How long do we have the barn?
faq.a: Tell Susan what time you'd like to gather and what your vendors need. Ask about access before setting your schedule. [CONFIRM: access window, setup the day before, end time]
You can reach Susan by email, call or text. [CONFIRM: Susan's reply time]

closing.heading: Walk your ceremony route.
closing.body: Come see the field and the barn before settling on a date. Tell Susan your approximate guest count and the season you're considering.
